entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-02
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Skip ignored configuration for JSON columns in model snapshot #37282
    11.0.0
  • SQL Server: Support vector indexes #37281
    11.0.0
  • Query opt-in for fetching vector properties #37280
    Backlog
  • Stop loading vector properties - query pipeline #37279
    11.0.0
  • Stop loading vector properties - model and change tracking #37278
    11.0.0
  • Stop loading vector properties from the database (by default) #37277
    11.0.0
  • Disconnected change tracker instance graph failing to commit anything #37276
  • EF Core 10 migrations do not convert ToJson() columns from nvarchar(max) to native json type when upgrading with UseCompatibilityLevel(170) #37275
  • Conflict with RowVersion/Concurrency Token in TPH with Owned Entity as JSON (ValidateJsonProperties throws exception) #37274
    11.0.0

Closed

  • ExecuteUpdate fails "The linq expression 'ti' could not be translated" (with PK subquery, join, multiple setters) #37247
    10.0.2
  • EF Core 10: InvalidOperationException doing primitive list join when list is empty #37216
    10.0.2
  • EF.Parameter or setting ParameterTranslationMode.Parameter doesn't work with IEnumerable with nullable type #37204
    10.0.2
  • SQL Server: support vector indexes #36835
  • Multiple owned instances with same ID do not throw #37253

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix TableSharingConcurrencyTokenConvention to skip JSON-mapped entities #37286
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #37285
  • Fix snapshot generation to capture column type for JSON columns #37284

Merged

  • [release/10.0] Apply pending selector before ExecuteUpdate #37262
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.2
  • [release/10.0] Fix empty scalar collection support #37248
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.2
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #37283
  • [release/10.0] Fix Parameter for primitive collections for IEnumerable with nullable type #37257
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.2

Updated

  • [release/10.0] Fix Cosmos parameter naming for FromSql and regular parameters #37273
  • [release/10.0] Always generate HasDiscriminator with type argument and property name in snapshot #37242
  • [release/10.0] Fix NullReferenceException when scaffolding named default constraints #37243
  • Fallback to OPENJSON with many parameters #37234
  • [release/10.0] Make FromSql work on entity types containing complex JSON #37235
  • Implement MergeOption #36556
    community-contribution
  • [release/10.0] Fix snapshot generation for complex collection properties #37271
